content.text: The user wants the repository's failing integration test isolated before any fix lands. First reproduce the failure deterministically, then bisect the fixture data to the smallest payload that still triggers the defect, and only then look at the adapter boundary where the exception surfaces.

I reproduced the failure locally and narrowed it down to the response adapter: the buffered body is re-parsed once per union level, and the innermost tool payload is where the malformed marker surfaces. The fix belongs in the converter dispatch, not in the adapter. Below is the run that demonstrates the failure and the minimal fixture that triggers it.
